action.action-desc: Ms. Pettersen (for herself and Mr. Lawler) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce

form.official-title: To amend title 5, United States Code, to modify certain requirements for employees in fire protection activities for worker’s compensation under chapter 81 of such title, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Wildfire Responder Protection Act.

section.header: Modification to requirements for employees in fire protection activities
section.text: Section 8143b(a)(1) of title 5, United States Code, is amended—

subparagraph.text: by inserting for all or a substantial part of the year after employee employed; and
by inserting fuels specialist, burn boss, prescribed fire crew member, after ambulance personnel,;

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (A), by inserting or planned ignition after fire suppression;
in subparagraph (B), by striking fire suppression; inserting fire suppression or planned ignition; and;

subparagraph.text: by inserting fuels reduction, after prevention,; and
by striking ; and at the end and inserting a period; and
